items.t: The live page is a feed headed "Serpentine Homes for Sale | Surrey Acreages & Estates," showing "1-12 / 16" results at reading, followed by one short editorial section ("Serpentine: Surrey's Equestrian Country"); feed counts change and that count is a snapshot, not a market statistic.

What the feed shows: all twelve visible cards are labelled "Serpentine," spanning acreage houses, blueberry farms, vacant land and Campbell Heights industrial-side parcels on the southern-lowland streets listed in the framing note above.

Live-page editorial (site copy, not verified fact): the page describes Serpentine as "Surrey's rural heart" of acreages and equestrian properties near King George Boulevard, Highway 99, South Surrey amenities and the US border — carried as the site's own framing only.

Schools confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file for the feed's south-Surrey ground: Morgan Elementary, 3366 156a St, Surrey; Earl Marriott Secondary, 15751 16 Ave, Surrey. A feed card for a 176 Street land listing names the Morgan Elementary and Earl Marriott Secondary catchments in its listing text — the schools are confirmed by name and address; the catchment claim is listing text only, and SD36 catchments are address-based with no locator run for this ground on record, so catchments here are UNVERIFIED.
Health care for the feed's ground: Peace Arch Hospital, 15521 Russell Avenue, White Rock, serves South Surrey.
Where 55+ stock sits relative to this ground: none of it is on the feed's acreage ground — the nearest verified complexes are the South Surrey corridor complexes and Cloverdale's two, in.

items.t: ALR frame — the rule book that actually governs most of this feed's ground: on Agricultural Land Reserve parcels, one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m², a secondary suite only inside the principal residence, and at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha); subdivision of ALR land requires Agricultural Land Commission permission outside limited regulation exceptions. Which feed parcels are in the ALR: UNVERIFIED — check parcel by parcel on ALC mapping; listing text is not an ALR determination.

Surrey SSMUH (urban lots only — not ALR parcels): a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop.

Secondary suites (Surrey, non-ALR): only one secondary suite per single-family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit, not within a coach house or garden suite, capped at 40% of the principal dwelling unit's habitable floor area.

Coach houses and garden suites (Surrey, non-ALR): allowed in all residential zones that allow detached houses, duplexes and houseplexes; 35–75 m², rising to 120 m² for lots zoned RA, R2, R2-O and R3 where the existing house or duplex is below maximum FAR; smaller R3–R6 lots require lane access; one extra parking space required.

City zoning and OCP: Surrey Zoning By-law, 1993, No. 12000 governs the ground, parcel by parcel in COSMOS; the current OCP is Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan Bylaw, 2026, No. 21900 — adopted June 15, 2026, replacing Bylaw No. 18020, which must never be cited as current.

Short-term rentals in Surrey: under 90 consecutive days per patron; only the owner may host, the owner must live at the property as their primary residence, tenants cannot run one, and a business licence at $358 per year is required.
Property taxes (city-wide): due July 2, with a 5% penalty if not paid by midnight July 2 and a further 5% penalty after September 2.

The label and the land point at two different ends of Surrey. The board community that contains Serpentine is "Cloverdale," whose town centre is at Highway 10 and Highway 15 in the city's north-east — while every visible feed card sits in the southern lowland toward the US border. A buyer who drives to "Cloverdale" to look at a "Serpentine" farm is in the wrong part of the city.
A zero row is not a missing row.

No City document will ever confirm a "Serpentine neighbourhood." The name is a board label only — there is no City of Surrey plan, neighbourhood page or boundary for it, so any source that describes Serpentine's "neighbourhood character" as a municipal fact is inventing it; the live page's "Surrey's Equestrian Country" line is the site's own editorial.

Servicing claims on this feed are listing text, and they drive value. Feed cards variously claim city water, wells, irrigation/ditch water and services "at lot line" — none verified in this research, and on farm ground the servicing answer matters more than the house; the same caution applies to one card's court-ordered-sale claim and others' preload/approval claims, which need court or City records, not listing text.

The schools a farm card names are real; the catchment claim is not verified. Morgan Elementary and Earl Marriott Secondary check out in the Ministry file by name and address — a listing naming them as "the catchment" is still listing text until an SD36 locator run for that address is on record.

faq.q: Can I buy a 55+ home in Serpentine?
faq.a: No verified one exists on this ground: Serpentine's verified 55+ ownership count is zero — the feed is acreages, farms and land with no age restriction. The nearest verified options are the South Surrey corridor complexes (six strata, plus the Sea Ridge Bays bare-land strata) if you mean the feed's southern ground, or Cloverdale's two complexes (Carriage House; The Estates at Manor Ridge) if you mean the board community.

faq.q: Is Serpentine in Cloverdale or South Surrey?
faq.a: Both labels are in play and they conflict, flagged rather than resolved here: the board files Serpentine as a sub-area of its Cloverdale community, while the live feed's cards sit on Surrey's southern lowland referencing Morgan Creek, Grandview Heights and the US border. Confirm which ground a specific listing sits on from its address, not from the sub-area label.

faq.q: What rules govern a second home or suite on a Serpentine acreage?
faq.a: Parcel by parcel: if the parcel is in the ALR, the ALC frame applies — principal residence capped at 500 m² with any suite inside it, plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (≤40 ha) or 186 m² (>40 ha). Surrey's urban suite, coach-house and SSMUH numbers apply only to non-ALR urban lots.

Morgan Elementary (3366 156a St) and Earl Marriott Secondary (15751 16 Ave) are confirmed by name and address in the Ministry K-12 file for this part of Surrey, and one feed card names both as catchments in its listing text — but SD36 catchments are address-based and no locator run for this ground is on record, so verify the exact address before relying on a school.

faq.q: My spouse is under 55. If we buy into a nearby 55+ complex instead, can we both live there?
faq.a: Yes — provincial rules require an exemption for a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement (or holds a legacy exemption), plus exemptions for live-in caregivers, legacy residents, children under 19 in the resident's care, and adult children cared for before 19.
